description: RTMO-m, one-stage multi-person body pose (17 COCO keypoints). Runs on the 512px thumbnail to give the album a body-pose axis the image embedding cannot see through a change of backdrop -- sit/stand/lie and limb configuration -- so selection can reward pose variety. One-stage matters: we have face detectors, not a person detector, and RTMO needs neither.

pad_value.source: rtmlib/tools/pose_estimation/rtmo.py::RTMO.preprocess -- padded_img = np.ones((*model_input_size, 3), dtype=np.uint8) * 114 fills the letterbox band with 114 gray, then no mean/std is applied (the stage constructs RTMO with mean=None/std=None, so BaseTool leaves the padded uint8 raw). Matches the mmpose projects/rtmo body7 export's TopdownAffine + Pad(pad_val=114) convention. Because scale is 1 with empty mean and std, pixel 114 and tensor 114.0 coincide.

license.training_data: body7 mix: COCO (CC-BY-4.0, commercial-friendly), plus AI Challenger, CrowdPose, MPII, sub-JHMDB, Halpe, PoseTrack18. Only COCO's terms are confirmed. license.note: DEVELOPMENT USE, UNVERIFIED. MMPose states Apache-2.0 for code AND weights and its maintainers confirm commercial permission (issues #2106/#2393), so this does not block release the way the InsightFace stack does -- but verified is false until a human confirms the live licence text, and the body7 training-data audit above is a separate, still-open gate. THIS ENTRY IS NOT LOADED BY workers/ml-runtime: the pose stage runs RTMO through rtmlib, which fetches and caches the ONNX under ~/.cache/rtmlib. The config is the audit-and-provenance record, not a host binding, so its preprocessing/output fields describe rtmlib's documented SDK pipeline and are NOT verified against the real graph -- rtmlib performs resize/normalisation and output decode internally, which is why postprocessing is null and mean/std are identity here. blake3/byte_size stay null for the same reason: no fetch_weights download owns this artifact yet.

notes: Body-pose signatures are pure geometry in packages/album-engine/memory_engine_album/pose.py: 17 COCO keypoints -> scale/translation-free joint angles -> mirror-invariant RMS distance -> conservative greedy clustering, bucketed by face count first because RTMO merges tight embraces into one body. The stage is services/pipeline/memory_engine_pipeline/stages/pose.py and writes <workdir>/pose-clusters.json. FALLBACK on record if RTMO ever misses in dense group shots: RTMPose-m + a person detector (also Apache-2.0), see docs/pose-model-proposal.md. DETRPose-M is the eval-harness challenger before any promotion here.
